The minidumps and adjacent LICENSE are copied from Bugsink's event-samples
repository, `minidumps/`. They originate from Google's Breakpad test data.
They are crash data, not executable code or a dependency on the Breakpad processor.

* `linux_null_read_av.dmp`: Linux AMD64 null read; also exercises supplied CFI.
* `ascii_read_av.dmp`: Windows x86 access violation with frame-pointer unwinding.
